newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to weak, USDA said.
Wk to date - 94,400 last week - 74,700 last year - 88,500

Inquiry moderate, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 4,500 slaughter steers and 2,500 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 94,400 head confirmed including 30,800 head or about 33 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 63.00; few Select with end Choice 1325 lbs 62.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225 103.00 hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 62.00-63.00, few mixed Commercial to Choice 1150 lb heifers and heiferettes, few cows 60.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 102.50 hot weights, delivered.
